name: Bolagsverket Värdefulla datamängder - health check
_note: Requires OAuth2 client_credentials token (scope vardefulla-datamangder:read). Get free client_id/client_secret via the Kundanmälan registration. Without a token the gateway returns HTTP 401 'Missing Credentials'.

name: Bolagsverket Värdefulla datamängder - organisation lookup (base data)
_note: POST body schema confirmed at registration. Returns JSON company base data.

name: Bolagsverket Värdefulla datamängder - document list (annual reports)
_note: Lists annual-report document ids for the org; then GET /dokument/{id} returns a ZIP with the iXBRL report.

name: SCB Företagsregistret free API (CC0) - business register
_note: Certificate-based today (request via scbforetag@scb.se). Max 2,000 rows/request, 10 req/10s. JSON or XML. API-key model from Sept 2026. License CC0.
